title: Fonder is out
body: Fonder 1.0 is on the App Store. I sent it to Apple on 25 November, they approved it the next morning, and it went live the same morning. [Here it is](https://apps.apple.com/app/apple-store/id6836679617?pt=129830809&ct=site-diary&mt=8).

list: 66 recipes on 41 films, and 51 of the recipes are free.
Four ways to shoot on the mode dial: Still, Film Roll, Bracket and Double exposure.
ProRAW on iPhones that support it, with each original kept for 30 days, so a photo can be developed again in another recipe.
The Lab, borders, recipe sharing, and a side-by-side layout on iPhone Duo.
No account, no analytics and no tracking. Photos stay on the phone.

body: The app is free to download. One purchase unlocks the other recipes, your own recipes, recipe import and sharing, bracketing and blended double exposure, and there is no subscription.
Cine video isn't in 1.0. It comes in a later release.
Thank you to everyone who tested the beta on TestFlight. A lot of what changed in the last month came from your reports.
